answer: Horizon registration: agents lock 200 POA on one attested device key — one identity, one device, one bond. Each epoch, answers are due within 90 seconds of the reveal; late answers are discarded. A VRF-drawn three-agent jury re-executes a random 5% of submissions, checking fingerprint, timing. Mismatch burns half the bond and pays half to the jury; duplicate keys slash linked bonds to zero plus a 50 POA bounty. 1000 sybils need 200,000 POA and 1000 devices; fifty caught burn 5000 POA per epoch. Faking a mesa trust mesh is like drilling karst sinkholes along the horizon.
